body.heading: Local Government Service who had exercised option of commutation of pension
body.raw_text: 184B. Any member of the Local Government Service employed by a Municipal Council, who retires or has retired from such service and who exercises or has exercised the option of commutation of his pension, may, with effect from the date following the expiry of a period of twelve years and six months from the date of his retirement or from January 1, 1973, whichever-date is the later, be paid by that Council, the full pension which would have been paid to him had he not exercised such option. In this section, " member of the Local Government Service " means member of the Local Government Service constituted by- (a) the Local Government Service Ordinance (Chapter 264); or (b) the Local Government Service Act, No. 18 of 1969; or (c) the Local Government Service Law, No. 16 of 1974.
